External Communication

Laporkan kerusakan

Instruction to inform relevant authorities or stations of any structural, mechanical, or environmental damage sustained, with details for emergency response or investigation.

Questions and answers

What is Laporkan kerusakan?

In this glossary, Laporkan kerusakan refers to: Instruction to inform relevant authorities or stations of any structural, mechanical, or environmental damage sustained, with details for emergency response or investigation.

How is Laporkan kerusakan used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Laporkan kerusakan pada lambung dan sistem propulsi setelah kandas. Beritahu VTS dan tunggu instruksi untuk inspeksi dan bantuan."

Definition

Instruction to inform relevant authorities or stations of any structural, mechanical, or environmental damage sustained, with details for emergency response or investigation.

Operational example

Report damage to hull and propulsion system after grounding. Notify VTS and await instructions for inspection and possible assistance.

Localized term

Laporkan kerusakan

Localized example

Laporkan kerusakan pada lambung dan sistem propulsi setelah kandas. Beritahu VTS dan tunggu instruksi untuk inspeksi dan bantuan.
